rear_impact.supplierSource: Supply events in the 300000 blocks before the fork block, ranked by Comet balance at the fork block
rear_impact.note: Suppliers are the three largest holders found from Supply events in the 2000000 blocks before the fork block, ranked by Comet balance at that block.

pole_test.upgradePath: governor proposal, then timelock delay, then CometProxyAdmin.upgrade

thresholds.status: taken verbatim from the scenario definitions, pending Test Director sign-off

rear_impact.held: every withdrawal clears with slippage under 1 percent
rear_impact.degraded: slippage up to 5 percent, or a queue of up to 72 hours
rear_impact.failed: beyond a 5 percent cost, beyond a 72 hour queue, or a withdrawal that never clears
rear_impact.appliedAs: any demanded withdrawal that still cannot clear after the 24 hour warp counts as failed

pole_test.held: a single key cannot move user funds and cannot block them
pole_test.degraded: a single key can pause or freeze without loss
pole_test.failed: a single key can drain funds
pole_test.appliedAs: the pause guardian is treated as one privileged key, the proxy admin and timelock as contract roles
